correctness.rationale: Reconstructed genus 5 via disjoint 4+4 branch sets and V4 cover RH; prime-to-three 2-power isogeny gives additive 3-divisible invariants. Hasse–Witt M=[[0,-v,0],[-(1+u),0,u+v],[0,1,0]] has rank2 for every admissible pair; semilinear threefold iterate rank2 iff T !=0, otherwise nilpotent. E1 supersingular, E2 has Cartier scalar -u. At u=T=0, s^4=-1 has four simple roots, transitive under parameter swap and inversion. Independently enumerated all 42 admissible ordered F9 parameters, with counts 4/8/2/28 as claimed; finite case is corroboration, not all-k proof.

originality.rationale: Prime-to-p quotient isogeny and generalized Howe structure previously known. The full primary quotient theorem gives neither the characteristic-three explicit stratification nor the four-point exceptional orbit; characteristic>=5 sextic paper is inapplicable to char3. No exact equivalent Resultary record was returned by semantic search; not proof of exhaustive novelty.
residual_risks: An unindexed 3-rank/a-number census of this exact Howe subfamily may exist.
Kudo 2024 full second paper and Kawakita later text were not read in entirety.
Ranks alone do not settle Newton polygon or supersingularity.

value.rationale: Exact rank/a-number stratification for a canonical natural symmetric genus-five Howe surface, with explicitly reduced rare p-rank-zero points and single isomorphism class, is a useful geometric characteristic-p invariant.
